'''Millennium Astro-Engineering''', also known simply as '''Millennium Engineering''', was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturer that produced the ''[[Millennium Hawk]]'' and [[Millennium fighter|''Millennium'' fighter]].<ref name="The Flight of the Falcon" />

[[Kea Moll]] spied on Millennium Engineering's manufacturing plants working for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].<ref name="The Droids Re-Animated" />
